items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Because he'd been on Broadway, working with Ziegfeld.

ctx.x: He was the leader of the military band that you were in?

Right, he was lieutenant. Bill Vodery. He took the examination in CHAUMONT and he was supposed to have two hours to do it, he did it in twenty minutes. Because he'd been on Broadway, working with Ziegfeld. So that's what happened.
Now, where did you go with Vodery and the band? You went to Europe, right?
